author: Cptnwhizbang
body:
[This is the Deity Workbook](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/u/0/d/1dNVWNztmjKzch-B40lv8Xcvj8vrCd5r0Nv9PRMDC5m8/htmlview#gid=529076720). It's maintained by mysterious figures who generally seem to know what they're doing. Check out the Early T10 section! 

Both deity and mage really kick off at 245 when you get Ultima. It's popular to go Beowolf for early T10 power and gear flexibility - this might help you get started and grind towers (important) early. I did this and now main Deity and it was a much more pleasant experience than forcing a setup that wasn't working well

author: Krozz_08
body:
I don't really know much about deity, I always played as heretic

But if you're interested in being a heretic, here's a relatively easy build to get. 

* Celestial staff (hands of Prometheus, 1 of Oceanus)

* Any T10 staff you have in good quality (1 heretic jewel)

* Menja's Hood (current event)

* Aaru robe (Ask someone if they have a Ptah, if not, wait for the Balor event and farm 2 lggt - lugus gauntlet)

* Baldr boots, or banshee. Or any boots that give you magic, or good ward with def and res. 

* In accessory, if someone gives you a Ptah, use ascended rings or try waiting for mimics and farm some Carl's rings.

* Heretic Corvus - Sequencer

All items need crit adornments, for spells you can use level 225 heretic spells, they have good damage to start with and high crit chance. At level 230 you can use the spells of the Deity Ara celestial class they have more damage and they heal you, but only have a 5% crit chance

Spells you'll need -

* Fey Flame V/Fey Frost V/Fey Spark V/Fey Tremor V (depending on which faction you are)

* Mimic's Mischief 

* Wyvern Speed

* Wyrm's Song

* Deific Channel 

* Gait of Snotra

* Outwill 

* Golem's Fortitude 

* Barrier II

* Divine Bastion

As a companion, you can use Golem of Ortanie, stonewarg, timber
